description:
[MDR Article 61 clinical evaluation report (CER) & equivalence screener. Statutory audit, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates clinical evaluation sufficiency under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 Article 61 and Annex XIV, scoring literature search protocols, benefit-risk ratios, PMCF plans, and auditing Article 61(5) competitor access contracts.
Usage: Pass clinical evaluation attributes and equivalence claims to audit sufficiency score before Notified Body submission.
Returns: JSON object with { deviceName: string, overallSufficiencyScorePercent: number, statutoryVerdict: string, equivalenceAudit: object, literatureProtocolAudit: object, clinicalDataSufficiencyAudit: object, pmcfAudit: object, gapFindings: array, mandatoryNotifiedBodySubmissionItems: array }.

benefitRiskRatioAcceptable.description: Whether clinical evaluation concludes that risks are acceptable compared to clinical benefits

clinicalSafetyAndPerformanceEndpointsBen.description: Whether clinical safety and performance endpoints are quantitatively benchmarked against state of the art

deviceName.description: Commercial trade name of the medical device under evaluation

deviceRiskClass.description: MDR Risk class of the device

isImplantableDevice.description: Whether device is implantable (triggers strict Article 61(4) clinical investigation rule)

lastLiteratureSearchCutoffDateIso.description: Date of most recent literature search cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD)

literatureAppraisalCriteriaDocumented.description: Whether weighted data appraisal criteria (methodology, relevance) are specified (MDCG 2020-6)

literatureSearchProtocolDefined.description: Whether a systematic literature search protocol (PICO, databases, search strings) is documented

ownClinicalInvestigationConducted.description: Whether pre-market clinical investigations were performed with the subject device

pmcfPlanFormulatedAnnexXivPartB.description: Whether a proactive Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) Plan is established

predicateDeviceAccessContractSigned.description: Article 61(5): For Class III/implantables, whether a contract with predicate manufacturer granting full technical doc access exists

reliesOnClinicalEquivalenceToPredicate.description: Whether clinical evaluation relies on equivalence to a predicate device (Annex XIV 3)

name: mdr_clinical_evaluation_screener
